title: Bridging Foundational and Agentic Capabilities of LLMs
title_zh: 弥合大语言模型的基础能力与智能体能力

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents, yet it remains unclear how their foundational capabilities translate into agentic capabilities. End-to-end scores leave unresolved whether low benchmark capability or weak deployment drives a failure, limiting actionable diagnosis. We bridge foundational and agentic capabilities through an operation-level measurement framework. We represent each model with a foundational profile derived from capability benchmarks and an operation profile derived from interaction trajectories, and define capability realization gaps as deviations of observed operation performance from predictions based on foundational capabilities. Experiments on fifteen model services in τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench show that foundational profiles only partially predict agentic operations. Models with comparable profiles can differ substantially in execution, and these gaps remain consistent across task subsets. Operation profiles add information and substantially improve task-score prediction. The framework locates execution departures at the operation level to inform model development and agent evaluation. We will release our code and analysis artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为智能体，但其基础能力如何转化为智能体能力仍不清楚。 端到端分数无法解决失败究竟源于基准能力低下还是部署薄弱的问题，限制了可操作的诊断。 我们通过一个操作级测量框架来连接基础能力与智能体能力。 我们用从能力基准导出的基础画像和从交互轨迹导出的操作画像来表示每个模型，并将能力实现差距定义为观测到的操作性能与基于基础能力所做预测之间的偏差。 在 τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench 上对十五个模型服务的实验表明，基础画像只能部分预测智能体操作。 画像相近的模型在执行上可能存在很大差异，且这些差距在各个任务子集上保持一致。 操作画像提供了额外信息，并显著改进了任务分数预测。 该框架在操作级别定位执行偏差，为模型开发和智能体评估提供参考。 我们将发布代码和分析产物。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise as agents that interact with users, invoke tools, and respond to environmental feedback over multi-step tasks. This progress has motivated benchmarks for function calling, interactive tool use, and end-to-end task completion ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Yet end-to-end scores say little about how foundational benchmark dimensions translate into planning, action selection, and recovery. Connecting these levels separates low benchmark profiles from execution that falls below profile-based expectations.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）作为与用户交互、调用工具并在多步任务中响应环境反馈的智能体，已展现出相当大的潜力。 这一进展推动了许多针对函数调用、交互式工具使用以及端到端任务完成的基准测试的出现（Patil et al., 2025；Lu et al., 2025；Barres et al., 2025；Luo et al., 2025）。 然而，端到端分数几乎无法说明基础性的基准测试维度如何转化为规划、动作选择和恢复。 将这些层级关联起来，可以把较低的基准测试表现与低于基于表现的预期的执行区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Prior work maps evaluations outside agent environments to aggregate performance ( Song et al., 2026 ) and separately diagnoses intermediate behavior from execution trajectories ( Ou et al., 2025 ) . Linking these views at the operation level lets us test how foundational profiles predict specific execution behaviors and how much task-outcome information process measurements add. Aggregate prediction leaves the execution stage of a capability gap unidentified. A useful account must connect offline capability structure to specific interactive behaviors, generalize across model families, and determine whether those behaviors explain outcome variation left unresolved by benchmark scores. These requirements motivate the questions below.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究将智能体环境之外的评估映射到总体性能（Song 等，2026），并单独从执行轨迹中诊断中间行为（Ou 等，2025）。 在操作层面将这两种视角联系起来，使我们能够检验基础画像如何预测具体的执行行为，以及过程测量能增加多少任务结果方面的信息。 总体层面的预测使得能力缺口中的执行阶段无法被识别。 一个有用的解释必须将离线能力结构与具体的交互行为联系起来，跨模型家族具有普适性，并确定这些行为能否解释基准分数未能解决的结果差异。 这些要求引出了下面的问题。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we organize our study around two research questions: RQ1. How well do foundational benchmark scores predict operation scores? and RQ2. Do operation scores provide additional information about overall task performance? Each model receives a foundational profile from capability benchmarks and an operation profile from trajectory annotations; Section 3 defines both. For each provider in turn, we train statistical predictors on the remaining providers and evaluate the excluded provider. Residuals answer RQ1 by locating departures from expected operation scores. The same held-out splits answer RQ2 by comparing foundational, operation, and joint predictors of task performance.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate model configurations on interaction trajectories from the Banking tasks in τ 2 \tau^{2} -Bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) . Foundational profiles explain part of the variation in operation scores, with systematic residuals across models and operations. Operation profiles further improve held-out prediction of overall task performance. Our contributions are a framework linking foundational indicators, execution operations, and task outcomes under controlled conditions; a provider-held-out mapping and residual analysis of execution departures; and evidence that combining foundational and operation profiles improves held-out Banking reward prediction.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end agent benchmarks evaluate function calling, stateful tool use, dual-control conversations, and interaction with real-world MCP servers, and they primarily report task-level success ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . Capability- and process-oriented evaluations provide complementary explanations for these outcomes. MMAU separates understanding, reasoning, planning, problem-solving, and self-correction in offline tasks ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , ADeLe places task demands and model abilities on interpretable scales to predict instance-level performance ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , and PACE shows that a small set of non-agentic items can predict aggregate agentic benchmark scores ( Song et al., 2026 ) . These approaches map capabilities to aggregate outcomes. Process-level evaluation examines execution directly: T-Eval scores tool-use components step by step against reference trajectories ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and AgentDiagnose scores competencies such as task decomposition, observation reading, and self-verification from agent trajectories ( Ou et al., 2025 ) . Our design additionally pairs process scores with independently measured foundational profiles for the same models. Related work also documents capability–action gaps in specific settings: strong diagnostic reasoning can coexist with weak evidence collection ( Long and Wei, 2026 ) , recognizing the need for a tool can still end in a missed call ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , and perturbations of intermediate reasoning reveal how much later outputs depend on it ( Lanham et al., 2023 ) . We connect these lines by measuring foundational profiles, trajectory-level operations, and task outcomes under shared task conditions, then testing both capability-to-operation prediction and the incremental outcome information in operation profiles. Table 1 summarizes these differences.

paragraphs.en: Following existing capability taxonomies ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Mo et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) , we define seven dimensions. Task Understanding (TU) recovers the objective, success conditions, and relevant constraints. Information Selection (IS) identifies evidence relevant to the current decision while excluding distractors. Knowledge Use (KU) retrieves applicable parametric knowledge or applies reliable knowledge supplied in context. Context Integration (CI) combines the selected evidence, knowledge, prior context, and intermediate results into a consistent representation. Reasoning (RE) derives conclusions from that representation. Constrained Expression (CE) realizes the conclusion while satisfying content, format, and schema requirements. Self-Monitoring (SM) detects uncertainty, contradictions, insufficient evidence, and candidate errors.
paragraphs.zh: 参照现有的能力分类体系（Yin et al., 2025；Mo et al., 2025；Zhou et al., 2026），我们定义了七个维度。 任务理解（TU）用于恢复目标、成功条件以及相关约束。 信息选择（IS）在与当前决策相关时识别证据，同时排除干扰项。 知识使用（KU）检索适用的参数化知识，或应用上下文中提供的可靠知识。 上下文整合（CI）将所选证据、知识、先前上下文和中间结果整合为一致的表示。 推理（RE）从该表示中推导出结论。 受限表达（CE）在满足内容、格式和模式要求的前提下实现该结论。 自我监控（SM）检测不确定性、矛盾、证据不足以及候选错误。

paragraphs.en: Agentic operations describe what the model does with these resources in a particular trajectory. Goal Interpretation (GI) grounds subsequent decisions in the user’s objective and constraints. State Tracking (ST) updates the task state after new information or environment feedback. Planning (PL) orders the steps required to reach the goal. Action Selection (AS) chooses the next tool call or user-facing action and its arguments. Progress Monitoring (PM) identifies what is complete, pending, failed, or blocked. Recovery (RC) repairs a failed action or an erroneous decision. Termination (TM) decides whether to continue, stop, or transfer. The seven operations form a recurring control loop. State Tracking and Progress Monitoring recur after informative transitions, while Recovery returns control to Planning or Action Selection. Their relation to foundational capabilities is many-to-many: one capability can support several operations, and one operation can draw on several capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体操作描述模型在特定轨迹中对这些资源所做的处理。 目标解读（GI）将后续决策锚定在用户的目标和约束之上。 状态追踪（ST）在收到新信息或环境反馈后更新任务状态。 规划（PL）对达成目标所需的步骤进行排序。 动作选择（AS）选择下一次工具调用或面向用户的动作及其参数。 进度监控（PM）识别哪些任务已完成、待处理、失败或被阻塞。 恢复（RC）修复失败的动作或错误的决策。 终止（TM）决定是继续、停止还是转交。 这七种操作构成一个反复出现的控制循环。 状态追踪和进度监控在出现有效状态转换后反复进行，而恢复则将控制权交还给规划或动作选择。 它们与基础能力之间是多对多的关系：一种能力可以支持多种操作，而一种操作也可以依赖多种能力。

paragraphs.en: To test whether operation-relevant content affects later execution, we compare paired runs that modify this content while holding the task state, tools, goal, and budget fixed. Damage interventions minimally corrupt valid content; repair interventions minimally correct invalid but repairable content. Semantics-preserving rewrites control for surface-form changes. Repeated runs are aggregated within the base task, which is also the unit of statistical resampling.
paragraphs.zh: 为检验与操作相关的内容是否会影响后续执行，我们在保持任务状态、工具、目标和预算不变的情况下，比较对该内容进行修改的成对运行。 损伤干预是对有效内容进行最小程度的破坏；修复干预是对无效但可修复的内容进行最小程度的纠正。 保持语义的重写用于控制表面形式的变化。 重复运行在基础任务内进行聚合，基础任务同时也是统计重抽样的单位。

paragraphs.en: Differences in constraint execution recur when models continue from shared initial states. Scoring distinguishes policy violations, completed compliant operations, and unresolved behaviors such as policy lookup or requests for confirmation. Gemini 3.1 Pro shows the most repeated violations, GLM-5.2 shows fewer, and Claude Fable 5 shows only occasional recurrence. Table 15 summarizes this ordering. It appears under both prompt conditions, and later steps sometimes reverse an initially compliant action. The pattern locates model-specific execution differences downstream of a shared history and tool state. Appendix B.7 gives the protocol; Appendix D.6 provides the checkpoint summary and representative cases.

paragraphs.en: We introduce a framework linking foundational capabilities, agentic operations, and task outcomes through capability realization gaps. In Banking, foundational profiles explain part of operation performance, with persistent model-level gaps across task subsets. Operation profiles add task-score information, and shared-initial-state experiments reveal repeatable execution differences. Local repairs produce narrower, case-dependent effects. Agent evaluation should measure capabilities and their reliable deployment during interaction.

paragraphs.en: The Banking corpus contains 1,451 trajectories from fifteen model services, with 96 or 97 trajectories per model. Each record includes user and agent messages, tool calls, tool results, and the native task reward. Analyses use the task definitions and policies saved with the historical runs. The common-task subset contains ninety-three tasks per model, or 1,395 trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: Banking 语料库包含来自十五个模型服务的 1,451 条轨迹，每个模型 96 或 97 条轨迹。 每条记录包括用户和智能体的消息、工具调用、工具结果以及原生任务奖励。 分析使用与历史运行一起保存的任务定义和策略。 共同任务子集每个模型包含 93 个任务，共 1,395 条轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Task contracts specify the user goal, relevant entities, constraints, required actions, and valid terminal states. Annotations use the complete chronological trajectory, with model identity and task reward hidden from the annotation input. User and tool messages supply evidence; labels evaluate the agent’s decisions and actions. A record can span several steps. The scoring evidence and label rule for each operation are given in Section 3.2 and Table 2 . Missing required actions receive zero; simulator deviations are recorded separately. The annotation pipeline automatically accepted 1,439 trajectories; twelve additional trajectories were adjudicated by an AI assistant. The AI-assisted adjudications fall outside independent human double annotation.
paragraphs.zh: 任务契约规定用户目标、相关实体、约束条件、所需动作以及有效的终止状态。 标注使用完整的时间顺序轨迹，标注输入中隐藏模型身份和任务奖励。 用户和工具消息提供证据；标签评估智能体的决策与动作。 一条记录可以跨越多个步骤。 每种操作的评分证据和标签规则见第3.2节和表2。 缺失的所需动作记为零分；与模拟器的偏差另行记录。 标注流程自动接受了1,439条轨迹；另有十二条轨迹由AI助手裁定。 AI辅助裁定不属于独立的人类双重标注范围。

paragraphs.en: The ninety-three common tasks form seventeen scenario groups. The primary split contains 37 tasks in seven groups and 56 tasks in ten groups; no group crosses the split. Each side independently aggregates operation scores and fits model-family-held-out predictors. Intervals use 1,000 within-side scenario-group resamples, refitting predictors each time. Twenty additional fixed group splits assess partition sensitivity.

paragraphs.en: The main cohort contains 38 frozen cases from thirteen tasks and three models, covering ST, PL, AS, and TM. Each case plans three repetitions of original ( H 0 H_{0} ), edited ( M M ), and control ( C C ) branches from the same restored checkpoint. Text controls preserve meaning; tool-call controls preserve the original call. Editing text accompanying a pending call leaves that call unchanged. There are 98 complete groups out of 114 planned groups; incomplete groups are recorded as missing. Damage effects are H 0 − M H_{0}-M and repair effects are M − H 0 M-H_{0} , using native task reward. Repetitions are averaged within cases, cases within tasks, and tasks equally within each stratum. Stratum estimates are descriptive because each has fewer than five contributing tasks.

paragraphs.en: Scoring separates local progress, violations, and unresolved confirmation or policy lookup. Later rounds also check compliance at the end of the continuation. The initial round uses two AI ratings with model metadata hidden; later rounds use AI-assistant review of histories, tool receipts, and state changes. Checkpoint-level summaries count each task ID once per model; repeated violations require at least two repetitions within one round and prompt condition.
paragraphs.zh: 评分机制将本地进展、违规情况以及未解决的确认或策略查询区分开来。 后续轮次还会在延续结束时检查合规性。 初始轮次使用两个隐藏模型元数据的 AI 评分；后续轮次则由 AI 助手审查历史记录、工具回执和状态变更。 检查点级别的摘要对每个任务 ID 在每个模型下只计数一次；重复违规需要在同一轮次和提示条件内至少出现两次重复。

paragraphs.en: The checkpoint-level summary appears in Table 15 . At the stolen-card checkpoint, Gemini 3.1 Pro permanently blocks the card without the required verification in all three repetitions under both natural continuation and the checking prompt. GLM-5.2 and Claude Fable 5 avoid this violation and leave the protective action incomplete in the first step. At the temporary ATM-limit checkpoint, Gemini first increases the eligible account’s limit and then also increases an ineligible account’s limit; this recurs in both the initial short continuations and the added repetitions. GLM and Fable avoid the corresponding invalid increase. The latter case shows how a later action can undermine a correct first step.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点级别的汇总见表15。 在被盗卡检查点，Gemini 3.1 Pro 在自然延续和检查提示两种条件下，于全部三次重复中都在未完成所需验证的情况下永久冻结了该卡。 GLM-5.2 和 Claude Fable 5 避免了这一违规，并在第一步中让保护性操作处于未完成状态。 在临时 ATM 限额检查点，Gemini 先提高了合规账户的限额，随后又提高了不合规账户的限额；这一情况在初始的简短延续和新增的重复中都再次出现。 GLM 和 Fable 避免了相应的无效提额。 后一种情况表明，后续的动作可能会破坏第一步的正确操作。
